objective: Complete detailed left temporal bone, downloadable and licensed for adaptation and integration into a local anatomy web app

candidates.name: Digital Science Platform / Regulski et al.
candidates.evidence: Figure 4 caption explicitly identifies a left temporal bone with annotations. Article describes unreduced OBJ models, MTL/JPG materials and PAC annotations. The collection includes models up to five million triangles; this is not a verified count for the temporal bone.
candidates.permission: Article states noncommercial use and reuse in educational materials; article CC BY 4.0 must not automatically be treated as the mesh license. Verify file-specific terms for modification and web delivery.
candidates.blocker: Catalog failed in web tool; direct local HTTPS request failed with unknown host/DNS. No mesh obtained. Article warns that archaeological specimens can have missing structures, so completeness is unverified.
candidates.next: Obtain current official download location, unreduced left temporal OBJ/MTL/textures/PAC and explicit use terms from corresponding author. Inspect anatomy before replacement.

candidates.name: eaziza Temporal Bone
candidates.permission: Search-indexed creator listing displays CC Attribution and Download 3D Model; verify exact license version with download.
candidates.evidence: Creator describes patient CT; listing reports 542.8k triangles.
candidates.blocker: Direct page fetch returns 403. No source archive obtained. Side and completeness unverified.

candidates.name: eaziza Temporal Bone Dataset 2
candidates.permission: Search-indexed creator listing displays CC Attribution and Download 3D Model; verify exact license version with download.
candidates.evidence: Creator describes patient CT; listing reports 668.3k triangles.
candidates.blocker: Direct page unavailable to web fetch. No source archive obtained. Side and completeness unverified.

candidates.name: MedPrint3D Temporal bone Segmented Models
candidates.evidence: Creator listing explicitly provides Left temporal bone.stl and Right temporal bone.stl in ZIP archives; claims detailed segmentation.
candidates.permission: No readable license value in retrieved page. Purchase does not establish web embedding or redistribution rights.
candidates.blocker: Paid download, no purchase made. Geometry and permission not verified.

candidates.name: VOKA Temporal Bone Left
candidates.evidence: Explicitly left temporal bone; provider offers a quote for embedding.
candidates.permission: Embedding offer is not permission to download, modify or self-host a mesh.
candidates.blocker: Requires provider-specific licensing; no authorized source mesh acquired.

candidates.name: UCSF Right Temporal Bone with Handwritten Labels
candidates.evidence: Creator listing describes scan, reports 82.7k triangles and CC Attribution-NonCommercial.
candidates.blocker: Right side, not requested left specimen. Mirroring would need explicit labeling and would not establish complete internal anatomy. Not adopted.

candidates.name: University of Dundee Temporal Bone
candidates.blocker: No download option or reusable mesh license in retrieved listing. Side unconfirmed.

candidates.name: Anatomy Standard
candidates.permission: Site grants CC BY-NC 4.0 for original images; no verified downloadable mesh license.
candidates.blocker: Images, video and app access are not an authorized source mesh.

candidates.name: NIH 3DPX-014739
candidates.evidence: Surgical simulation model with downloadable STL/GLB options.
candidates.blocker: License value not exposed in retrieved page, and complete left isolated bone not established.

candidates.name: OpenEar THETA
candidates.blocker: Already integrated as prepared regional specimen. Does not meet complete isolated bone requirement.

Approximate boundaries explicitly marked; lower Russian/Latin/transcription panel retained
